Writes a 0 terminator at out[n]. Returns n. This is the boundary helper: hand-written repack loops (one per call site, each a chance to get the stride wrong) become one call. n <= 0 writes only the terminator and returns 0. POINTER ARITHMETIC IS IN BYTES: to pack starting at cell i of a cell array, pass cells + i*8, not cells + i.
